eligibility.adult_definition: at least one valid visit whose psma_stage contains code A
eligibility.fail_action: do not fit confirmatory reproductive-state model

reproductive_state.meaning: egg and/or larval stage was available/detectable during the season at an adult-confirmed site-year
reproductive_state.rationale: juvenile/metamorph stages were not added after seeing their larger structural counts

visit_observation_rule.psma_1_stage_only_J_or_M_or_U_or_NA: reproductive observation unresolved for this endpoint

detection_model.missing_percent_surveyed: drop visit from endpoint observation model
detection_model.weather_wind: secondary detection sensitivity only, not primary process covariates

process_model.formula: logit(theta_siteyear) = b0 + b_depth*shallow + b_fish*fish_present + b_year*z_year + b_area*z_log_area
process_model.theta_definition: P(R_st=1 | adult stage confirmed in site-year)
process_model.shallow_definition: first valid max_depth in site-year is <=1 m
process_model.deeper_definition: first valid max_depth in site-year is >1 m
process_model.fish_definition: Y if fish observed on any valid visit; N if at least one determination and none Y; otherwise missing
process_model.area_definition: first valid site_length_m x site_width_m; log1p transformed
process_model.year_definition: calendar year centered and scaled across eligible site-years

hypotheses.H1: shallower wetlands have lower reproductive-stage occupancy conditional on confirmed adults
hypotheses.H2: fish presence is associated with lower reproductive-stage occupancy conditional on confirmed adults
hypotheses.H3: any temporal trend is estimated jointly but is not used to retune H1/H2

likelihood.state: single-season occupancy likelihood for R_st within adult-confirmed site-years
likelihood.zero_false_positive_assumption: E/L detections have negligible false-positive error

multiplicity: H1 depth is primary; fish is prespecified secondary. No modifier winner-picking.
sensitivity: require >=2 valid endpoint visits after the first adult-A detection date
include weather and wind in reproductive detection submodel
forbidden_claims: causal effect of depth or fish
